title: Tool credentials could only be set platform-wide
problem: One value served every tenant, so a tenant could not bring its own provider key.
fix: Tool Configuration has a tenant scope. A tenant value wins over the platform value and badges reflect the caller's tenant.

title: Platform alerts were polled instead of routed through Alertmanager
problem: The API polled Prometheus and there was no Alertmanager, no silencing and no resolved notifications.
fix: Alertmanager ships in the chart, Prometheus routes to it, it posts firing and resolved alerts to the API webhook and optionally to Slack.

title: Archives lived on pod disk with no way to restore
problem: Dumps were lost on restart and there was no restore path.
fix: Archives go to object storage with a checksum and a volume in local mode, and an admin can restore a run from the page.

title: Edge bundle signing failed open
problem: Without a signing key each API pod minted its own and the edge runtime accepted unsigned bundles from any tenant.
fix: Production refuses to sign without a key, bundles carry the tenant, and the runtime rejects unsigned or foreign bundles unless a dev switch is set.

title: Drift was only recorded for runs the API handled inline
problem: Queued runs never fed drift detection and nothing caught missed runs.
fix: Every terminal path records drift and a locked backlog scan catches anything missed.

title: Queued trigger runs never wrote their outcome
problem: A trigger fired through the queue kept its last status forever.
fix: The consumer writes status, time and error back to the trigger.

title: Stale-run sweeper held its lock forever
problem: A session-scoped advisory lock on a pooled connection was never released.
fix: The sweeper uses a transaction-scoped lock.

title: Seventy runtime tools had no palette documentation
problem: Their docs only showed when the live catalogue fetch succeeded.
fix: tool-docs.ts is generated from the runtime tools and CI checks it is current.

title: MCP tools a server stopped offering were deleted silently
problem: Re-discovery removed the rows with no notice to the owner or the model.
fix: They are flagged as orphaned, the agent is told, and the page offers a one-click remove.

title: Feature flags produced by the API were never read
problem: Four flags had no consumer, so the role table and the UI disagreed.
fix: They drive the sidebar and resource scoping, and the docs table matches the code.

title: Pipeline Surgeon never received the last good output or traceback
problem: Failure diffs had no expected sample and no traceback.
fix: The executor keeps the last good output per node and passes it with the real traceback.

title: Duplicating an agent and reading conversations ignored access rules
problem: Any tenant member could copy another user's agent, including its system prompt, and read conversations on it.
fix: Both follow the shared access rule and members see only their own executions unless their role allows more.

title: Archive restore refused valid dumps written on Windows
problem: Text mode wrote CRLF line endings, so the checksum never matched on restore.
fix: Dumps pin the newline and the reader tolerates CR.

title: Storage and restore tests never ran locally
problem: Async tests without the asyncio marker were skipped locally and failed in CI.
